newsitem.title: GERMANY: KAL to up ex-Germany cargo rates 6-12pct.
newsitem.headline: KAL to up ex-Germany cargo rates 6-12pct.

text.p: Korean Air said it will raise its ex-Germany cargo rates by 6 to 12 percent according to destination from March 1.
Germany cargo sales manager, Robert M. Instinsky, told Reuters rates would be increased by a lower percentage to Korea and south-east Asia and by a higher figure to Japan.
But he did not give precise details of the rates rises.

Instinsky said demand for Korea had picked up after a slow start to 1997 although it was still stagnating a little in the wake of the recent disturbances and the collapse of the Hanbo Group conglomerate. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
